content.text: Generate one 1024x1024 PNG concept image for a cohesive six-image style set. Subject: collapsed terminal ruin map for a top-down 2D survivor game. True overhead top-down view, not isometric. Broken screen walls, console islands, slanted combat corridor, stronger black comic-style shadows, shattered industrial floor geometry. Unified visual style: hand-painted graffiti feeling, rough heavy black linework, marker-pen strokes, dark cyberpunk wasteland, restrained dirty low-pollution background, readable tactical map shapes. Rainbow color only as very thin edge accents, cyan suggests player paths, electric magenta suggests enemy danger traces. Make it a loose style candidate, not a polished final asset. No UI, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no characters, no sprites, no 3D, no photorealism, no pixel art.
